name: Home - Sorted By Registration Opening

race.courseNote: Two loops around Governors Island with views of New York Harbor and Lower Manhattan; start and finish near the Festival Area. USATF-certified.
race.name: Go Nuts for Donuts 10K
race.photoAlt: Colonels Row on Governors Island, by the start and finish
race.photoCredit: Brian W. Schaller, Free Art License

race.courseNote: Just under one full loop of Prospect Park, finishing with a sprint up Center Drive. Benefits the YMCA of Greater New York. USATF-certified.
race.name: Great Gobble 5K
race.photoAlt: Runners on the Prospect Park drive

race.courseNote: A multi-loop course around Central Park; full course details are posted closer to race day. USATF-certified.
race.name: Big Apple Half Marathon
race.photoAlt: Runners on the Central Park drive

race.courseNote: A 13.1-mile wintry tour of Central Park on a looped course; details are posted closer to race day. USATF-certified.
race.name: Central Park Half Marathon
race.photoAlt: Runners on the Central Park drive

race.courseNote: Starts in North Brooklyn, runs along the East River waterfront under the Williamsburg, Manhattan and Brooklyn Bridges, then up Fulton Street and Flatbush Avenue to finish in Prospect Park. Wave starts 7:00 to 9:40 AM. USATF-certified.
race.name: Brooklyn Experience Half Marathon
race.photoAlt: Runners on the Prospect Park drive

race.courseNote: A lollipop course in Harriman State Park with over 2,600 ft of climbing. Also offered the same day: a 10K (1,400 ft) and a 10K ruck. 6-hour cutoff; the course closes at 3:00 PM.
race.locationName: Anthony Wayne Recreation Area, Harriman State Park
race.name: Big Bear Squatch North Half Marathon
race.photoAlt: The Ramapo-Dunderberg Trail through forest in Harriman State Park

race.courseNote: Point to point from the Elm Ridge parking lot in Windham to North/South Lake in Haines Falls: 30 km (18.6 mi) with about 4,800 ft of climbing and hard aid-station cutoffs (6-hour limit). The 50th edition; wave starts 9:00 to 10:35 AM.
race.name: Escarpment Trail Run
race.photoAlt: The view from the Catskill Mountain House site at North-South Lake, near the finish

race.courseNote: Point-to-point 53-mile ultramarathon through the Catskills starting at 591 Big Hollow Rd, Windham, on the northern Black Dome Trail and then the Long Path from Acra Point to downtown Phoenicia. Organizer: "approximately 15,000 ft. of climbing"; rocky, precipitous terrain that gets progressively harder; up to 3-4 hours between aid stations.
race.locationName: Catskill Mountains (Long Path, Windham to Phoenicia)
race.name: Manitou's Revenge 53 Miler

race.courseNote: 50 miles on wide carriage roads through forests and over ridgelines of the Shawangunk Mountains; 18-hour cutoff. Also offered: 26.2-mile trail marathon and 2-, 3- or 4-person relays.
race.name: Rock The Ridge 50 Miler

race.courseNote: Approximately 10-mile trail loop from the Summit Field picnic area (12 Bear Lane); 50 miles = five loops. Also 50K, 20M and 10M. 12-hour limit; must start last loop by 4:30 PM; headlamp required.
race.name: Febapple Frozen 50 Miler

race.courseNote: Three loops of roughly 10.5-11 miles, about half technical single track on the Metacomet Trail and the rest double-track. 9-hour cutoff. Cupless race. A 17K (one loop) is also offered.
race.name: Traprock 50K

race.courseNote: 3 x 16.6-mile loops on a 16+ mile course with minimal road crossings and lots of single track through Blood Root Valley, High Rock Park, La Tourette Park and the Field of Dreams. Starts at 501 Brielle Ave. 13-hour cutoff (7 PM); last-lap cutoff 3:00 PM at Nature Center. Also 50K and half marathon. Benefits the Greenbelt Conservancy.
race.name: NYC Trail Mix 50 Miler

race.courseNote: Starts at Center Drive and finishes at Harry's Wall in Prospect Park (organizer shows a map only, no written route).
race.name: PPTC Turkey Trot: Race for Reconciliation 5 Miler

race.courseNote: Three full loops of Prospect Park solo, or a 3-person relay with each runner doing one ~3.33-mile loop. USATF-certified course.
race.name: Cherry Tree Ten Miler and Relay

race.courseNote: 3 loops of Van Cortlandt Park's cross-country course, in the back hills and around the flats.
race.name: The VCTC Pete McArdle 9-mile XC Trail Race

race.courseNote: Out-and-back on the Hudson riverwalk from Losee Field to Kingsland Park, toward the Sleepy Hollow lighthouse.
race.name: Trudy Dunbar Memorial 5K Turkey Trot

race.courseNote: Multi-loop boardwalk course along the waterfront at South Beach.
race.name: The Unforgettable Staten Island Half Marathon

race.courseNote: Hilly urban course (~1,137 ft gain, steep hills) with views of Manhattan; not USATF certified and not an exact distance. Open roads: expect red lights.
race.name: Jersey City Hillers FREE Half Marathon Course Challenge

race.courseNote: Through the neighborhoods of Jersey City, starting at Newport. Organizer says the course is USATF-certified and sanctioned, and is 'subject to change for 2027 race'.
race.name: The Jersey City Marathon

race.courseNote: Through the neighborhoods of Jersey City, starting at Newport. Organizer says the course is 'subject to change for 2027 race'.
race.name: The Jersey City Half Marathon

race.courseNote: New street course in Long Island City for 2026, the first year of this course. Expect street closures. The course map is published only as an image.
race.locationName: Long Island City (28-11 47th Ave, near LaGuardia Community College)
race.name: Queens Marathon

race.courseNote: About 100 miles from Huckleberry Point Trailhead to Belleayre Resort. Crosses four NYS Wilderness Areas, summits 12 of the 33 Catskill High Peaks, and includes the full Devil's Path. Extremely technical terrain. The organizer gives both 25,000+ ft and 27,000+ ft of gain.
race.name: Catskill 100 Miler

raceEdition.entryNote: Registration closes the day before the race, or earlier if it reaches capacity.
raceEdition.priceNote: Non-member price through Oct 26 (members $54). Then $65 through Nov 16, and $75 until registration ends.

raceEdition.entryNote: Registration closes the day before the race, or earlier if it reaches capacity.
raceEdition.priceNote: Non-member price through Nov 9 (members $99). Then $135 through Dec 7, and $145 until registration ends.

raceEdition.entryNote: Registration closes the day before the race, or earlier if it reaches capacity.
raceEdition.priceNote: Non-member price through Oct 26 (members $81). Then $100 through Dec 8, $110 through Jan 25, $125 through Feb 22, and $135 until registration ends.

raceEdition.entryNote: Registration closes the day before the race, or earlier if it reaches capacity.
raceEdition.priceNote: Non-member price through Oct 28 (members $139.50). Then $165 through Dec 17; later prices are not listed yet.

raceEdition.entryNote: Capped at 400 runners across all three events. It has sold out each of the last four years, typically by the end of March. Charity bibs and free hardship entries are available.
raceEdition.priceNote: Includes a $5.20 sign-up fee. The price rises after Dec 31, 2026.

raceEdition.entryNote: You must meet one qualifying standard: an Escarpment finish under 6 hours in the last 2 years, a road or trail marathon under 4:15 in the last year, a finish at a listed qualifying race in the last year, or 18+ mile trail race results reviewed by the race director. Applications open in early 2027 (exact dates not announced). Capped at 275 runners; your card is charged only if you are accepted.

2027 edition, 5:00 AM start. Registration on UltraSignup opens Feb 1, 2027 to past finishers (Manitou veterans) only; general registration opens Feb 22, 2027. Everyone signs up onto a temporary waitlist and is sent an invitation to complete registration once the organizer determines they are qualified. Non-veterans who sign up Feb 1-21 are removed from the waitlist without notice. The UltraSignup page does not spell out the qualification standard (an unofficial tourism listing says a 50+ mile finish within the last two years). Field limited by wilderness-area rules; no cap number stated. Refunds minus UltraSignup fee until May 1.
raceEdition.priceNote: Entry fee not listed on the official registration page.

raceEdition.entryNote: 2027 edition; start time not stated. Fundraising event: register via PledgeIt, then every participant must raise a $350 minimum for Mohonk Preserve before race day (packets not released until met). Organizer says registration is limited and will sell out (no cap number given). Full refund only within 24 hours of registering; no deferrals or transfers. Cancel on or before Mar 14, 2027 to have the fundraising minimum removed. Five 'Raise the Ridge' bibs for applicants for whom fees/fundraising are a barrier.
raceEdition.priceNote: Registration fee not shown on the official pages; $350 fundraising minimum applies on top.

raceEdition.entryNote: 2027 edition. Open registration on RunSignup. 50 Miler starts 7:00 AM (50K 8:00 AM, 20M 9:00 AM, 10M 10:00 AM). All finishers must be done by 7:00 PM. No cap or registration close date stated. 50% refund until 8 weeks before race. Note: page description still contains stale text 'Race Date: February 21, 2026'; header shows Feb 20, 2027.
raceEdition.priceNote: 50 Miler current price; rises after Oct 31, 2026 11:59 PM EDT (new price not listed). 50K $130.

raceEdition.entryNote: 2027 edition, 50K starts 8:30 AM (17K 9:30 AM). First-come registration on UltraSignup opens Thu Nov 26, 2026 at 12:00 AM ET; once at capacity a waitlist starts automatically (cap number not stated), filled in registration order with 2 days to respond. No formal qualifier, but organizer advises sufficient experience such as a recent marathon. 50% refund before Mar 1; no transfers or deferrals.
raceEdition.priceNote: Entry fee not listed yet on the official registration page.

raceEdition.entryNote: 2026 edition, 50 Miler starts 6:00 AM (50K 7:00 AM, half 8:00 AM). Open registration on UltraSignup until Thu Nov 12, 2026 11:59 PM ET. Very limited: page showed only 5 spots left in the 50 Miler (14 in 50K, 29 in half) on 2026-10-28. Refund policy not stated.
raceEdition.priceNote: 50 Miler, before UltraSignup taxes/fees ($211.17 total). 50K $155.

raceEdition.entryNote: 24th annual Thanksgiving Day race. Open online registration on RunSignup until sell-out (cap 2,947 regular bibs) or Nov 25 at 11:59pm. Two waves: Wave 1 at 8:15am, Wave 2 at 9:00am; runners who want overall prizes must run in Wave 1. Charity path: 153 charity bibs at $100 each, with 100% of proceeds going to the American Indian Community House; charity bib sales close Nov 25 at 6pm.
raceEdition.priceNote: Regular bib $47 (plus $3.82 RunSignup processing fee). Early-bird $42 ended Sep 13; charity bib $100.

raceEdition.entryNote: The 2027 date has not been announced. PPTC's site only says this is 'our February race'; the race page still shows the 2026 edition (Sun Feb 15, 2026, 10am). In 2026 entry was online only (no race-day registration), with no refunds or deferrals, and relay team members each paid an individual fee.
raceEdition.priceNote: 2027 prices not announced (2026 was $35 early bird in Nov 2025, then $44 and $55).

raceEdition.entryNote: Open online registration on RunSignup until 9:00am race morning (Saturday after Thanksgiving). Bib pickup and baggage open at 8:00am. No participant cap listed; commemorative buffs for the first 100 registrants. Some third-party listings wrongly show Sunday Nov 29; the official page says Saturday Nov 28.
raceEdition.priceNote: Single price $35 (plus $3.10 sign-up fee, $38.10 total); no price tiers.

raceEdition.entryNote: Open registration via Elite Feats; 8AM start, rain or shine. QDR members get a discounted race code via the newsletter (or by email); QDR+ members get a deeper discount. All fees non-refundable and do not roll over. Same weekend: QDR 5K (Dec 5), Queens Marathon and QDR Half (Dec 6). No cap or registration deadline stated.
raceEdition.priceNote: Standard $50 (registration options); the page's price table shows $54.50*, apparently including fees. QDR member $44.15*, QDR+ member $33.80*.

raceEdition.entryNote: Open to ages 10 and up (a separate 1-mile Gobbler Trot at 9:30am is for kids 7-9). Register by Oct 31 for early-bird price and a t-shirt; fees rise Nov 1 and shirts are not guaranteed after that. Race-day registration and bib pickup 8:30-9:15am at the Tarrytown Senior Building, 240 W. Main St. Division winners get a prize turkey.
raceEdition.priceNote: Early-bird $30 through Oct 31 (plus $2.80 fee); $40 from Nov 1; $50 race day.

raceEdition.entryNote: Open online registration on RunSignup until 11:00pm the night before (Mar 19). Date of birth and phone number required; T-shirt included. No cap stated.
raceEdition.priceNote: Single price $65 (plus $4.90 fee, $69.90 total); no increases listed.

raceEdition.entryNote: 10th annual free, low-key club challenge (a marathon course challenge starts at 7am the same day). Free registration on RunSignup closes Dec 5 at 11:59pm; waiver required. Self-timed: email a Strava/Garmin link with map to the organizers to qualify for a medal and placing, using total elapsed time.
raceEdition.priceNote: Free ($0 race fee, $0 processing).

raceEdition.entryNote: Open registration on RunSignup. Organizer says the race sold out the past two years and expects to sell out again. The 2027 race is a 2028 Boston Marathon qualifying event. Ages 18-99. 7:00 AM start. $25 fees each for deferral (until Mar 21, 2027), switching distance, or transfer. No registration close date or charity bib program is published.
raceEdition.priceNote: Marathon $200 until Dec 31, 2026 11:59 PM EST. The struck-through $225 is the later price. Fees may be extra.

raceEdition.entryNote: Open registration on RunSignup, run alongside the marathon. Organizer says the races sold out the past two years and expects another sellout. 7:00 AM start. $25 fees each for deferral, switching distance, or transfer. No registration close date is published.
raceEdition.priceNote: Half marathon $150 until Dec 31, 2026 11:59 PM EST. The struck-through $180 is the later price. Fees may be extra.

raceEdition.entryNote: Open registration on RunSignup opens Nov 1, 2026. The marathon is part of a race weekend that runs Apr 30-May 2, 2027 and also includes a 5K, 10K, half marathon, kids 1K, and multi-race challenges. 7:30 AM start. The page names no Boston-qualifier status, registration close date, or charity bib program.
raceEdition.priceNote: Marathon adult price $129 as listed. Ages 16-18 pay $84. No price-change dates are listed.

raceEdition.entryNote: Open registration via Elite Feats. QDR members get discounted rates (QDR member $116.60, QDR+ $80.38 per the pricing table). 8 AM start, rain or shine. All fees are non-refundable. No registration close date or time limit is published. The QDR Half Marathon runs the same day, and a 5K/10K runs Dec 5 in Flushing Meadows Corona Park.
raceEdition.priceNote: Full marathon is $150.00 under 'Registration Options'. The page's pricing table shows $158.00 standard, probably including fees, so the page is inconsistent. Confirm at checkout.

raceEdition.entryNote: Entry by application. A 100-mile or 100K finish within the last two years qualifies, as do pre-approved qualifier races such as Manitou's Revenge, Hyner 50K, Vermont 100/100K, and Eastern States 100. Other comparable efforts can be submitted with the application. Half of spots are reserved for women and non-binary runners. Wave starts of 15 runners every 5 minutes begin at 11 AM Friday, Aug 6. Finish cutoff is Sunday 3 PM. The registration page lists a free application but does not say whether applications are open now or when the window closes.
raceEdition.priceNote: 100 Miler entry $480.25 (same for men and women/non-binary). The application is free and a pacer is $27.62. The page doesn't say whether fees are included.

description: Every distance over the next year sorted by Registration opens: races whose registration opens soon come first, soonest first, then races you can already enter, and races with no opening date announced go last.
